title: tambora slaps strobe the lasers, beams recut every half bar
story: La Makina's merengue at 129 BPM (onset autocorrelation 14.8-15 ticks a beat, 59 a bar): every beat a low tambora/bass hit, bright tambora slaps on the off-beats, the guira scraping 8ths. Each hit type has its own carrier on the mango-carnival lasers: the beat thickens the beams and shakes the frame (prominent hits >12.5 add a zoom punch and a brightness flash), the slap strobes laser brightness, the guira ticks contrast, and every two beats the beams relaunch at a new angle in mirrored stations. The pre-roll stretches the trails and saturation as the onsets climb; 3031 releases them for the jaleo of slaps; at 3224 the drums thin and the trails stretch long and glow, following the voice and accordion chord by chord, until the drums slam back at 3338 into the steady loop. The dark background steps tint every bar, and the scene length (escena 14.4 s) puts the obstacle reshuffle exactly on the break at 3226, so the beams relaunch with the voice.
